property_summary: For any fuzzed newOwner, transferOwnership succeeds only when newOwner != address(0) and then c.owner() equals newOwner; the mutant inverts this, succeeding on the zero address and reverting on every non-zero address.
change_summary: Invert the zero-address requirement so passing address(0) succeeds and any non-zero address reverts, changing which new owner values become observable via owner().
